Organisms map to Fluid Grid blocks and are saved in Instapage as that client's My Blocks."},{"id":"34:46","text":"Section-level components, each a Fluid Grid block (Figma grid layout) of containers holding molecules. In a client library they become <Client> / Hero / … and, once approved, that client's Instapage My Blocks. Starting structures, not layouts to reuse unchanged: DesignChamp composes each page."},{"id":"33:9","description":"Molecule: eyebrow + title + subtitle + description from Headline and Paragraph atoms. Instapage: separate native headline/paragraph elements stacked in one container; eyebrow/subtitle/description resolve to the paragraph (or headline) font role. Words from the approved copy doc only."},{"id":"33:30","description":"Molecule: the Button atom as Primary / Secondary / Tertiary. Hierarchy is a semantic role; fill, border, radius, label color come from Semantic tokens set per client. Instapage: native buttons (styled per button); tertiary can be a native text link. CTA wording exact."},{"id":"33:34","description":"Molecule: Action instances side by side. Instapage: separate native buttons in one container (horizontal element flow). One primary action per section is the usual choice, but that is the client's and DesignChamp's call."},{"id":"33:88","description":"Molecule: a Fluid Grid container with a background (color, border, radius, padding are native container settings) holding Text Group + Action; Image variant adds the Image atom. Image overlay: text over a container/block background image; overlay tint verified only on block (Instablock) backgrounds; otherwise bake the tint into the approved image. No gradients: not a verified native container setting."},{"id":"34:88","description":"Organism: hero as a Fluid Grid block. Split = Text Group + Button Group (7 cols) beside the Image atom (5 cols). Overlay = text over the block background image with an overlay color (Instablock background image + overlay, a native block setting). Save the approved client version as a My Block."},{"id":"34:89","description":"Organism: section heading (Text Group) over three cards, each a native container with a background. Mobile stacks by m-order."},{"id":"34:142","description":"Organism: why (Text Group) beside a native Form Library form. After-submit behavior, integration and conversion goal go in IP · Build annotations."},{"id":"34:181","description":"Organism: closing call to action on the inverse surface. Text Group + Button Group in two containers."}]}
